b0001-text-01.machineText: 本指南說明 Wails 繫結系統的內部運作方式，協助想瞭解自動產生程式碼背後機制的開發人員掌握其原理。
b0001-text-01.sourcePreview: This guide explains how the Wails binding system works internally, providing insights for developers…

b0003-text-01.machineText: Wails 繫結系統由三個主要元件組成：
b0003-text-01.sourcePreview: The Wails binding system consists of three main components:

b0004-text-01.machineText: *收集*：分析 Go 程式碼，以擷取服務、模型及其他宣告的相關資訊
b0004-text-01.sourcePreview: *Collection*: Analyzes Go code to extract information about services, models, and other declarations

b0005-text-01.machineText: *設定*：管理繫結產生程序的設定與選項
b0005-text-01.sourcePreview: *Configuration*: Manages settings and options for the binding generation process

b0006-text-01.machineText: *轉譯*：根據收集到的資訊產生 JavaScript/TypeScript 程式碼
b0006-text-01.sourcePreview: *Rendering*: Generates JavaScript/TypeScript code based on the collected information

b0009-text-01.machineText: 收集程序負責分析 Go 套件，並擷取服務、模型及其他宣告的相關資訊。此程序由 `collect` 套件處理。
b0009-text-01.sourcePreview: The collection process is responsible for analyzing Go packages and extracting information about ser…

b0011-text-01.machineText: *Collector*：管理套件資訊，並快取收集到的資料
b0011-text-01.sourcePreview: *Collector*: Manages package information and caches collected data

b0012-text-01.machineText: *Package*：表示正在分析的 Go 套件，並儲存收集到的服務、模型及指示詞
b0012-text-01.sourcePreview: *Package*: Represents a Go package being analyzed and stores collected services, models, and directi…

b0013-text-01.machineText: *Service*：收集服務型別及其方法的相關資訊
b0013-text-01.sourcePreview: *Service*: Collects information about service types and their methods

b0014-text-01.machineText: *Model*：收集模型型別的詳細資訊，包括欄位、值及型別參數
b0014-text-01.sourcePreview: *Model*: Collects detailed information about model types, including fields, values, and type paramet…

b0015-text-01.machineText: *Directive*：剖析並解讀 Go 原始碼中的 `//wails:` 指示詞
b0015-text-01.sourcePreview: *Directive*: Parses and interprets `//wails:` directives in Go source code

b0017-text-01.machineText: 收集器掃描專案中指定的 Go 套件
b0017-text-01.sourcePreview: The collector scans the Go packages specified in the project

b0018-text-01.machineText: 收集器識別服務型別（其方法將公開給前端的結構）
b0018-text-01.sourcePreview: It identifies service types (structs with methods that will be exposed to the frontend)

b0019-text-01.machineText: 收集器會收集每項服務的方法資訊
b0019-text-01.sourcePreview: For each service, it collects information about its methods

b0020-text-01.machineText: 收集器識別模型型別（在服務方法中用作參數或傳回值的結構）
b0020-text-01.sourcePreview: It identifies model types (structs used as parameters or return values in service methods)

b0021-text-01.machineText: 收集器會收集每個模型的欄位及型別參數資訊
b0021-text-01.sourcePreview: For each model, it collects information about its fields and type parameters

b0022-text-01.machineText: 收集器處理在程式碼中找到的所有 `//wails:` 指示詞
b0022-text-01.sourcePreview: It processes any `//wails:` directives found in the code

b0024-text-01.machineText: 轉譯程序負責根據收集到的資訊產生 JavaScript/TypeScript 程式碼。此程序由 `render` 套件處理。
b0024-text-01.sourcePreview: The rendering process is responsible for generating JavaScript/TypeScript code based on the collecte…

b0026-text-01.machineText: *Renderer*：統籌服務、模型及索引檔案的轉譯作業
b0026-text-01.sourcePreview: *Renderer*: Orchestrates the rendering of service, model, and index files

b0027-text-01.machineText: *Module*：表示單一產生的 JavaScript/TypeScript 模組
b0027-text-01.sourcePreview: *Module*: Represents a single generated JavaScript/TypeScript module

b0028-text-01.machineText: *Templates*：用於產生程式碼的文字範本
b0028-text-01.sourcePreview: *Templates*: Text templates used for code generation

b0030-text-01.machineText: 轉譯器會為每項服務產生一個 JavaScript/TypeScript 檔案，其中包含與服務方法對應的函式
b0030-text-01.sourcePreview: For each service, the renderer generates a JavaScript/TypeScript file with functions that mirror the…

b0031-text-01.machineText: 轉譯器會為每個模型產生一個與模型結構對應的 JavaScript/TypeScript 類別
b0031-text-01.sourcePreview: For each model, the renderer generates a JavaScript/TypeScript class that mirrors the model struct

b0032-text-01.machineText: 轉譯器會產生重新匯出所有服務與模型的索引檔案
b0032-text-01.sourcePreview: The renderer generates index files that re-export all services and models

b0033-text-01.machineText: 轉譯器會套用 `//wails:inject` 指示詞所指定的所有自訂程式碼注入
b0033-text-01.sourcePreview: The renderer applies any custom code injections specified by `//wails:inject` directives

b0076-text-01.sourcePreview: The binding system supports several directives that can be used to customize the generated code. The…

b0078-text-01.machineText: `//wails:inject`：將自訂 JavaScript/TypeScript 程式碼注入產生的繫結
b0078-text-01.sourcePreview: `//wails:inject`: Injects custom JavaScript/TypeScript code into the generated bindings

b0079-text-01.machineText: `//wails:include`：在產生的繫結中包含其他檔案
b0079-text-01.sourcePreview: `//wails:include`: Includes additional files with the generated bindings

b0080-text-01.machineText: `//wails:internal`：將型別或方法標記為內部項目，防止其匯出至前端
b0080-text-01.sourcePreview: `//wails:internal`: Marks a type or method as internal, preventing it from being exported to the fro…

b0081-text-01.machineText: `//wails:ignore`：在產生繫結時完全忽略某個方法
b0081-text-01.sourcePreview: `//wails:ignore`: Completely ignores a method during binding generation

b0082-text-01.machineText: `//wails:id`：為方法指定自訂 ID，覆寫預設的雜湊式 ID
b0082-text-01.sourcePreview: `//wails:id`: Specifies a custom ID for a method, overriding the default hash-based ID

b0084-text-01.machineText: 在收集階段，收集器會識別並剖析 Go 程式碼中的指令
b0084-text-01.sourcePreview: During the collection phase, the collector identifies and parses directives in the Go code

b0085-text-01.machineText: 指令會與對應的宣告（服務、方法、模型等）一併儲存
b0085-text-01.sourcePreview: The directives are stored with the corresponding declarations (services, methods, models, etc.)

b0086-text-01.machineText: 在轉譯階段，轉譯器會套用指令以自訂產生的程式碼
b0086-text-01.sourcePreview: During the rendering phase, the renderer applies the directives to customize the generated code

b0104-text-01.machineText: 繫結產生器以高效率為設計目標，但仍有幾點需要注意：
b0104-text-01.sourcePreview: The binding generator is designed to be efficient, but there are a few things to keep in mind:

b0105-text-01.machineText: 第一次執行時會建立待掃描套件的快取，因此速度較慢
b0105-text-01.sourcePreview: The first run will be slower as it builds up a cache of packages to scan

b0106-text-01.machineText: 後續執行會使用快取資訊，因此速度較快
b0106-text-01.sourcePreview: Subsequent runs will be faster as they use the cached information

b0107-text-01.machineText: 產生器會處理專案中的所有套件；對大型專案而言，這可能相當耗時
b0107-text-01.sourcePreview: The generator processes all packages in the project, which can be time-consuming for large projects
